title: The /join magic link opened in another browser still finishes the induction with the answers given

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: sendSignupLink (app/sign-in/actions.ts:211-214) stamps no funnel_seq on the account, unlike the seq path (:158), and the induction answers sit only in the fq_pending_induction cookie (join actions.ts:732-734). Mail apps and Instagram open links in a different browser, so the person lands on /feed with a generated handle and no name, photo or town; the lead row that holds the name is never used to recover. Production 2026-11-27: 28 beta_induction leads, 16 converted (57%). Fix: stash the pending answers server side against the lead (signup_leads already has payload and a claim token) and stamp the funnel on the account at send time, so /join/complete can finish from any browser.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
